translations.web: For every head is bald, and every beard clipped. There are cuttings on all the hands, and sackcloth on the waist.
translations.bsb: For every head is shaved and every beard is clipped; on every hand is a gash, and around every waist is sackcloth.
translations.kjv: For every head shall be bald, and every beard clipped: upon all the hands shall be cuttings, and upon the loins sackcloth.
translations.asv: For every head is bald, and every beard clipped: upon all the hands are cuttings, and upon the loins sackcloth.
